data.name: Automation.CheckForUpdates.HelpText
data.value: Consulta la página de versiones de github en busca de una versión más reciente.
data.comment: Screen-reader help on the main window's "Check for updates" button. "github" is lower case on purpose, here and in every other spoken string: a screen reader treats the mid-word capital in "GitHub" as an abbreviation and spells it out, "G, I, T, hub", where the lower-case form is read as one word. Verified against a real screen reader. Visible labels keep the proper capitalisation, so the About window's button says GitHub while its Automation twin does not. The two keys naming github.com are lower case for a different reason: that one is a domain.

data.name: Body.MainExplanation.Lead
data.value: Any unneeded files below are [safe to delete].
data.comment: Main window intro, key 1 of 3 (the lead). Rendered prominent (heading tier): the reassurance the window opens on. "Any" and not "The": the same sentence shows over a count of zero, so it must read correctly with no files below it. Keep it one short clause. The bracketed phrase becomes a hyperlink into the README's "Is it safe?" section (rendered in MainWindow.xaml.cs BuildIntroLeadLine); the brackets are the delimiter and are not shown. This is the screen's strongest safety claim and the only link on it, so keep the brackets on whatever phrase carries that claim in this language.

data.name: Body.MainExplanation.Why
data.value: Están en {InstallerFolder}, donde quedaron cuando se desinstaló un programa ({0}), un parche más reciente sustituyó a otro ({1}) o el editor lo retiró ({2}). InstallerClean solo enumera archivos que el propio Windows da por terminados.
data.comment: Main window intro, key 2 of 3 (the why, rendered muted). {0} = Reason.Orphaned, {1} = Reason.Superseded, {2} = Reason.Obsoleted. Keep the parenthetical structure so all three column-Reason labels stay reachable from the body copy after translation.

data.name: Body.MainExplanation.Action
data.value: Delete them permanently, or move them to a backup folder until you're satisfied nothing needs them. Put them back into {InstallerFolder} and everything is restored.
data.comment: Main window intro, key 3 of 3 (the action, rendered in the body tier). It names delete first because the tier above says these files are safe to delete and this line carries straight on from that claim; the button order is a separate matter and does not govern it. The second sentence covers BOTH actions and is literally true of each: a cached package counts as present if and only if its recorded LocalPackage path exists, and putting a file back at that path under the same name is what restores it. Keep the folder named rather than "back where they were": it is the whole instruction, and it is the one thing the window never said before, leaving people to find it in the README. "Until", not "while": the point is that there is a finish to reach.

Replaces the "safe to delete" lead, which reads wrong above dead buttons. The reason-specific banner below it (Body.PendingReboot.*) carries the why; keep this one short.

data.name: Body.RegisteredMissingFromDisk
data.value:
This installer file is missing. It causes no trouble now, and won't until the day you try to repair, update or uninstall the program it belongs to. That step can then fail, because Windows looks for this file and it isn't there.
To try and fix it, download that program's installer from its maker and run it over your existing copy (don't uninstall first, uninstalling is itself a step that needs this file). Use the version you have installed if you can get it, as Windows may reject a different one. This should restore the file and leave your settings alone, but Microsoft doesn't guarantee it, and its own last resort is reinstalling the program.
data.comment: Shown in the Registered Files details pane when a selected product's installer file is gone from disk. Generic with no product name interpolated: the recovery advice is identical for every program, and a possessive on a name ending in s reads wrongly.

data.name: Error.AdminRequiredBody
data.value:
Windows le negó el acceso a InstallerClean, así que se detuvo. No se ha eliminado nada.
InstallerClean ya se estaba ejecutando como administrador, así que volver a iniciarlo de esa forma no servirá de nada. Windows no dice nada más sobre qué denegó el acceso, así que no hay nada concreto que puedas probar.

data.name: Error.InstallerDbUnavailableTitle
data.value: No se pudieron leer los registros de Windows Installer

data.name: Error.InstallerDbEmpty
data.value: Los registros de Windows Installer llegaron completamente vacíos: ni un solo programa instalado ni una sola actualización reclama un archivo de instalación en caché. Eso no ocurre en un equipo que funciona (incluso una instalación nueva de Windows tiene alguno), así que o los registros están dañados o no se pudieron leer, y un análisis que se creyera esta respuesta marcaría por error como huérfano cada archivo de {InstallerFolder}. InstallerClean se detuvo en lugar de eso. No se ha eliminado nada.

data.name: Error.MsiAccessDenied
data.value: Windows Installer no dejó que InstallerClean enumerara lo que hay instalado. InstallerClean ya se estaba ejecutando como administrador, así que volver a ejecutarlo como administrador no cambiará nada. Sin esa lista no hay forma segura de saber qué archivos en caché siguen haciendo falta, así que InstallerClean se detuvo. No se ha eliminado nada.

data.name: Error.MsiNonSuccess
data.value: Windows Installer no pudo darle a InstallerClean una lista legible de los programas instalados: {0} entradas seguidas llegaron ilegibles (último código de error {1}). En lugar de trabajar con una lista leída a medias, InstallerClean se detuvo. No se ha eliminado nada.

data.name: Error.MsiEnumerationNeverEnded
data.value: Windows Installer nunca señaló el final de la lista de programas instalados: InstallerClean se rindió tras {0} entradas (último código de error {1}). De una lista sin final no hay que fiarse, así que InstallerClean se detuvo. No se ha eliminado nada.

data.name: Error.MsiPatchEnumerationNeverEnded
data.value: Windows Installer nunca señaló el final de la lista de parches de un programa: InstallerClean se rindió tras {0} entradas (último código de error {1}). De una lista sin final no hay que fiarse, así que InstallerClean se detuvo. No se ha eliminado nada.

data.name: Error.ScanCorrelationFailed
data.value: InstallerClean couldn't match the Windows Installer records against what's in {InstallerFolder}. Almost nothing the records point at is actually there, and almost nothing that's there is named by any record, so nothing could be shown to be unneeded. Nothing has been offered and nothing has been removed.

data.name: Error.ScanNoRegisteredFileInFolder
data.value: InstallerClean couldn't match the Windows Installer records against what's in {InstallerFolder}. The folder has files in it, but not one record points at anything in there, so nothing could be shown to be unneeded. Nothing has been offered and nothing has been removed.

data.name: Error.ScanRecordsUnreadable
data.value: InstallerClean no pudo leer lo suficiente de los registros de Windows Installer para estar seguro de qué sigue haciendo falta: la lista de programas instalados llegó incompleta, y leer esos mismos registros directamente desde el registro de Windows también dio errores. Un archivo podría parecer huérfano solo porque el registro que lo nombra era uno de los ilegibles, así que InstallerClean se detuvo. No se ha eliminado nada.

data.name: Error.ScanCacheRootUnresolved
data.value: InstallerClean couldn't get Windows to resolve the true path of {InstallerFolder}, so no file could be shown to be inside it and none was offered for cleanup. This scan found nothing because that check failed, not because the folder is clean. Nothing has been removed.

data.name: Error.InstallerLockUnavailable
data.value: InstallerClean couldn't take the lock Windows Installer uses to stop two programs changing installed software at once, so it couldn't rule out a file becoming needed part-way through, and nothing has been deleted. Try again, and restart Windows if it keeps happening.

data.name: Error.MoveInstallerLockUnavailable
